2: For the Chief Musician; upon an eight-stringed lyre. A Psalm of David. Help, Lord; for the godly man ceases. For the faithful fail from among the children of men.
3: Everyone lies to his neighbor. They speak with flattering lips, and with a double heart.
4: May the Lord cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that boasts,
5: who have said, "With our tongue we will prevail. Our lips are our own. Who is lord over us?"
6: "Because of the oppression of the weak and because of the groaning of the needy, I will now arise," says the Lord; "I will set him in safety from those who malign him."
7: The words of the Lord are flawless words, as silver refined in a clay furnace, purified seven times.
8: You will keep them, Lord. You will preserve them from this generation forever.
9: The wicked walk on every side, when what is vile is exalted among the sons of men.
